_comment: PNW mapd binary release pin. The ~20 MB pfeiferj `mapd` binary is intentionally NOT vendored in git (keeps clones and device updates small). system/mapd/installer.py downloads it at launch to the PERSISTENT /data/mapd/mapd (outside the git tree, survives auto-update git clean) and verifies `sha256` -- `install_path` below is NOT that live location, it's a legacy in-tree fallback only used off-device where /data isn't writable. To upgrade mapd: change version + url + sha256 + size here (get the sha with `sha256sum mapd`), nothing else -- BUT first check the device for a leftover /data/mapd/.override flag (`ssh comma@<ip> 'python3 -m openpilot.system.mapd.installer --check'`): while that flag exists, installer.py freezes the installed binary and silently ignores every pin bump (by design, for hand-deployed test builds -- see docs/GOMSGQ-SHADOW-FIX.md). Clear it with `rm /data/mapd/.override` on the device before expecting a version bump here to take effect. SHADOW-RACE NOTE (mapd230pin2pnw, 2026-08-16): v2.3.0 pins gomsgq v0.1.10 which PREDATES the shadow-reader race fix, and its default settings shadow-subscribe carState (same as the prior v2.2.0 pin), so the latent `Invalid Msgq message size` drive-load panic is UNCHANGED from before this bump -- not introduced by it. If that panic ever shows in a drive log, the definitive fix is a PATCHED build (mapd v2.3.0 + gomsgq bumped past commit fd495fe 'validate shadow reads against publisher laps') via the dirkpetersen/mapd arm64 CI, re-verified with the on-device A/B harness (docs/GOMSGQ-SHADOW-FIX.md). v2.3.0 also exposes a per-message shadow toggle (setShadowCarState), but forcing it off reliably requires clearing the device's persisted MapdSettings param because the v1->v2 settings migration hard-codes shadow_car_state=true.
name: mapd
